title: The Plan Tool
description: 分镜与终端离线剧本相同：先 update_plan 列出三步，再 ls / 写入 .tmp/s05/hello.ts / 跑通，每步重写同一份清单。终端不读你的提示词；这里也不是在跑 code.ts。 / Same storyboard as the terminal offline demo: update_plan with three steps, then ls / write .tmp/s05/hello.ts / run it, rewriting the same checklist each time. The script ignores your prompt; this player is not live code.ts.

steps.content: Create a file called hello.ts that prints a greeting, then run it.
steps.annotation: User sends a multi-step task. Offline mode ignores the text and plays a fixed script.

steps.content:
1. Inspect the workspace — in_progress
2. Create .tmp/s05/hello.ts that prints a greeting — pending
3. Run it to verify the output — pending
steps.annotation: First tool is update_plan, not shell. The plan lives in the harness as a function_call.
The handler stores currentPlan[] and re-renders the checklist. No files are touched.
shell does the real work. Exactly one step is in_progress.
Inspect done. Next turn the model rewrites the whole plan, not a diff.

steps.content:
1. Inspect the workspace — completed
2. Create .tmp/s05/hello.ts that prints a greeting — in_progress
3. Run it to verify the output — pending
steps.annotation: Same three steps, new statuses. Harness replaces currentPlan wholesale.
○ became ✓ on step 1; ▸ moved to step 2.
The write lands in .tmp/s05/, gitignored like earlier chapters.
Disk changed via shell, not via update_plan.

steps.content:
1. Inspect the workspace — completed
2. Create .tmp/s05/hello.ts that prints a greeting — completed
3. Run it to verify the output — in_progress
steps.annotation: Still one in_progress step at a time.
Harness replaced currentPlan again. Disk still unchanged until the next shell.
The greeting printed. Last plan rewrite will mark every step completed.

steps.content:
1. Inspect the workspace — completed
2. Create .tmp/s05/hello.ts that prints a greeting — completed
3. Run it to verify the output — completed
steps.annotation: 3/3 done. The checklist is harness state, gone when the process exits (s09 persists it).
Same three steps, all completed. update_plan still did not touch the disk.

steps.content: Planned 3 steps, wrote .tmp/s05/hello.ts, and ran it. The plan lived in the harness the whole time — update_plan never touched the disk.
steps.annotation: No function_call items → loop stops. Same ending as the terminal offline script.
